exposure: prophylactic tranexamic acid (TXA) administration during cesarean delivery
cohort: The study included more than 2705 patients undergoing cesarean delivery at a tertiary care regional rural and underserved maternal care center, comparing groups before and after TXA protocol implementation.
finding: Prophylactic policy-driven TXA administration during cesarean delivery significantly decreased PPH rates, blood loss, and the need for blood transfusions.
mod_finding: Prophylactic TXA administration during cesarean delivery was effective in reducing PPH rates and blood loss associated with this mode of birth.
